cuts.description: A problem on the electricity network is causing power to go on and off in the area.
cuts.message: We are currently experiencing problems with the electricity supply in your area. Our engineers have attended the fault, and have made an emergency repair to restore power to as many premises as possible. It is our intention to return to make a permanent repair as soon as we can. I'm sorry, but we can't give you a time for this at present. Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience this may cause.

cuts.description: We're carrying out planned work in your area. For our engineers to carry it out safely they need to turn the power off. We're doing this work as it's essential to provide reliable electricity supplies to your area. We're sorry for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your patience.
cuts.message: The electricity supply to your premises may currently be affected by planned work. You should have received a letter explaining this. We hope to be able to restore your supplies by the planned time of 13:30. Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience this is causing.

cuts.description: This work was due to take place on the 23rd October 2026 but was cancelled due to storm Austen. Following a customer request we will be connecting a new substation to the electricity network. This equipment controls and delivers electricity into your area. To ensure our engineers can carry out this work safely we will need to temporarily switch off your power. Due to the amount of work required we will need to switch off your power for a longer period. Once completed this will improve the reliability of the electricity network in your area and provide the customer with their desired outcome. These works will also provide automation in the local area which will help with faster restoration times in the event of an unplanned fault as we appreciate your area has been impacted with unplanned power cuts in the last 6 months. This work is taking place near Church Road.
cuts.message: The electricity supply to your premises may currently be affected by planned work. You should have received a letter explaining this. We hope to be able to restore your supplies by the planned time of 15:00. Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience this is causing.

cuts.description: This was work previously cancelled due to access restrictions which have been arranged and is why works are taking place on a Saturday. We're carrying out work to connect a new property to the electricity network. This connection will provide the property with a safe and reliable electricity supply. As the local electricity network operator in your area, we're responsible for connecting new properties when an electricity supply is requested. To carry out this work safely, we need to temporarily switch off your electricity while this work is completed. It is not safe to carry out this type of work while the electricity network is live. We understand that power interruptions are inconvenient and we will do everything we can to keep disruption to a minimum. This work is taking place in the Blackborough Road area.
cuts.message: The electricity supply to your premises may currently be affected by planned work. You should have received a letter explaining this. We hope to be able to restore your supplies by the planned time of 06:00. Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience this is causing.
